name: pine-ui
description: Modern React component library with design tokens
author: Pine UI

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pine-ui/tokens run build && pnpm --filter @pine-ui/react run build
scripts.version:packages:patch: pnpm --filter @pine-ui/tokens exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @pine-ui/react exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run version:packages:patch && npm run build && npm run publish:all && git push --follow-tags
